carousels.throughline: Google Ads buries 20% of your buyers in the ‘Other searches’ report, but you can recover them with one simple filter.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads hides 23% of your buyers in plain sight

body.text: The ‘Search terms’ report shows what people actually typed to find your ad, but most accounts never open it.
‘Other searches’ is where Google groups low-volume or new queries, and it holds 23% of your buyers.
Add a filter for ‘Conversions > 0’ to find the hidden buyers and stop wasting budget on strangers.
Move high-converting terms to your keyword list—this one filter recovers 23% of your sales.

reel_beats.hook: Gmail moves your email to Primary after two replies—not opens

body.text: Gmail’s algorithm watches replies more than opens, so two replies from the same person move you to Primary.

Ask a question in your email to spark replies—even a simple ‘How’s your week?’ boosts trust.
Check your reply rate—under 2% means Gmail sees you as low trust and buries your emails.

carousels.hook: Google Ads wastes €18 of every €100 on 3-second clicks
carousels.throughline: Most Google Ads accounts waste 18% of their budget on 3-second clicks, but a simple filter can block them forever.

reel_beats.hook: Google Ads wastes €18 of every €100 on clicks that bounce in 3 seconds

body.text: 3-second clicks usually mean bounces—people who leave immediately and never convert.
Most accounts ignore this waste and keep paying for dead clicks, draining €18 of every €100.
Add a filter for ‘Avg. session duration < 3 sec’ to spot the waste and block it for good.
Exclude these clicks with a negative audience—this one filter hands back €18 of your spend.
